about: Asks the set test command runs (npm run test-set-asks): each ask with the sets it should find, best first, by set id. They are places a cutscene could be set, in plain words, and their expected sets were chosen from the shipped looks (packages/sc2-asset-catalog/data/set-looks.json), so they are marked reviewed: false until someone has checked them against the pictures. Asks never name a map, campaign, character or story.
